text: I think you'll really enjoy this Creamy Oven-Baked Risotto recipe! It features some of your favorite ingredients, like milk and parmesan cheese, which are staples in many of the recipes you've liked in the past. The addition of cream of mushroom soup and chicken stock gives it a rich and savory flavor profile that's similar to the stews you often enjoy. Plus, it's a relatively quick and easy recipe that should fit within your typical cooking time frame. Give it a try and see what you think!
